proof_body:
by
  intro f K hf hK
  have key : ∀ x y, f y ≤ f x := by
    intro x y
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have hd : 0 < f y - f x := by linarith
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ (K - f y) / (f y - f x) := div_nonneg (by linarith [hK y]) hd.le
    have ht : 0 < (K - f y) / (f y - f x) + 1 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨t, htdef⟩ : ∃ t, t = (K - f y) / (f y - f x) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← htdef] at ht
    have hne : (1 : ℝ) + t ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h1 : 0 ≤ 1 / (1 + t) := by positivity
    have h2 : 0 ≤ t / (1 + t) := by positivity
    have h3 : 1 / (1 + t) + t / (1 + t) = 1 := by
      field_simp
    have c := hf.2 (Set.mem_univ (y + t * (y - x))) (Set.mem_univ x) h1 h2 h3
    have e : (1 / (1 + t)) • (y + t * (y - x)) + (t / (1 + t)) • x = y := by
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [e] at c
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at c
    have hp : 0 < 1 + t := by linarith
    have c2 : f y * (1 + t) ≤ f (y + t * (y - x)) + t * f x := by
      have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right c hp.le
      have e2 : (1 / (1 + t) * f (y + t * (y - x)) + t / (1 + t) * f x) * (1 + t) = f (y + t * (y - x)) + t * f x := by
        field_simp
      rwa [e2] at h4
    have h5 := hK (y + t * (y - x))
    have h6 : t * (f y - f x) = K - f y + (f y - f x) := by
      rw [htdef]
      field_simp
    nlinarith
  intro x y
  exact le_antisymm (key y x) (key x y)
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f → (∀ x, f x ≤ K) → ∀ x y, f x = f y
